name: Custody Console
look: Four empty presence rings surround a human-scale arrival mark; none is labeled as a control seat.
search: The dormant materialization panel expects a verified collection authority, asset receipt, and actor profile that Manifest v1 cannot yet provide.

name: Bounded Loadout Bench
look: Four tool outlines and one evacuation map are painted directly onto the bench.
search: Mara's ledger records who borrowed each tool and which consequence it can absorb.

uses.text: The Signal Veil is fitted for one stealth approach and logged against the operation.
The Coherence Nail is checked against the retreat plan before anyone carries it outward.

name: Archive Relay Aperture
look: A dark radial gate sits between two evidence vaults with an empty keyed decoder socket.
search: The gate can retain a commissioned calibration after the portable key is removed.

uses.text: The Archive Cipher commissions both directions of the Echo Observatory route and records the source chain.

name: Parzival Testimony
look: One recording is preserved beside three visible gaps and an unaltered timing trace.
search: The surviving intervals point toward Meme Farm 17 without claiming what happened inside the gaps.

uses.text: The Memory Lantern separates one attributed farm-route detail from a later reconstruction.

name: Recovery Channel
look: One capsule response arrives half a beat later than the repeating terminal chorus.
search: The delayed response identifies itself as Iri Vale and asks for a consent witness before separation.

uses.text: The Loopbreaker Patch interrupts the repeating control signal long enough for Iri to answer independently.
The Consciousness Capsule is secured for an evacuation chosen by its occupant.

name: Auditor Terminal
look: The report shows prevented failures beside a shorter list of voices classified as divergence.
search: Every stability gain has a named operator, a measurable cost, and a group that did not authorize it.

uses.text: The Data Spike opens one audited maintenance path and leaves its intervention visible.
The Signal Veil crosses one observation lane without altering the report.
The Chimera Access Spine proves the alternate route is safe for construct bodies.

name: Convergence Controls
look: Three control paths are marked expose, reroute, and dismantle; none is presented as consequence-free.
search: The current alignment can be changed only by a committed group action with an attributable operator.

uses.text: The Oneirocom Reality Anchor stabilizes the chamber long enough to make one accountable choice.
The Convergence Key exposes all three authored resolution paths without selecting one.
The Data Spike records the chosen control intervention in the engine audit.

name: Green Loom Relay Aperture
look: A dormant living gate has an empty covenant bed woven through its calibration frame.
search: Once commissioned, the gate stores the covenant in its own living circuit rather than drawing power from the portable thread.

uses.text: The Green Loom Thread commissions both directions of the Signal Orchard route and records the repair covenant.

name: White Rabbit Relay Aperture
look: A patched radial receiver faces an unlit route map beyond the market roofs.
search: The receiver can retain a public route calibration without retaining the courier device.

uses.text: The White Rabbit Relay commissions both directions of the Commons route and publishes the return signal.

name: Chimera Relay Aperture
look: A broad radial gate has a construct-safe socket separated from the lab's inventory controls.
search: The route calibration can persist without retaining a spine or classifying its installer as equipment.

uses.text: The Chimera Access Spine commissions both directions of the Boneyard route under a consent-safe configuration.

name: Delta Signal Anchor Bed
look: A low teal calibration frame stands beside the largest channel junction.
search: A completed sector scan would register the channel braid without treating any one memory as the source.

name: Archive Meridian Gate
look: A coral-lit station gate faces the coldest listening bowl.
search: The route leads outward to Archive Meridian and inward through the commissioned Archive Cipher aperture.

name: Rabbit Signal Freeport Gate
look: A patched departure frame shares its return signal with every courier mast in the commons.
search: The route leads outward to Rabbit Signal Freeport and inward through the commissioned White Rabbit aperture.

name: Glass Signal Anchor Bed
look: A low teal frame shelters beneath one unbroken resonant leaf.
search: A completed scan would register the terrace without claiming the garden can predict danger.

name: Spillway Signal Anchor Bed
look: A coral calibration lamp reflects in the shallowest public conduit.
search: A completed scan would mark the safe water line and disclose the remaining Oneirocom telemetry.

name: Green Loom Expanse Gate
look: Living cable has grown around a teal station frame without covering its public controls.
search: The route leads outward to Green Loom Expanse and inward through the commissioned Loom aperture.

name: Chimera Reach Gate
look: A wide gate preserves separate lanes for repaired constructs, salvage, and unknown remains.
search: The route leads outward to Chimera Reach and inward through the commissioned Chimera aperture.

name: Loomwatch Signal Anchor Bed
look: A low frame is tied into the causeway strain gauges beside the central mist tower.
search: A completed scan would register route strain without granting the fixture authority to close a path.

name: Meridian Route Index
look: Four authored station marks surround shelves of blank route receipts.
search: The index distinguishes authored trunks, generated interiors, and future forks by owner and policy version.

name: Consent Workboard
look: Every work order names a requester, subject, repair boundary, and stop condition.
search: Unclassified remains stay untouched until an authored process can establish consent or safe salvage.

name: Maintenance Commons
look: A public board links every shelter pump, reed filter, and living circuit to a current steward.
search: No generated place becomes sanctuary merely because its description sounds welcoming.

name: Freeport Departure Receipts
look: The board lists only committed routes, current return signals, and the last accountable traveler.
search: Fork proposals have an empty column reserved for the future runtime capability.
